verdict.rationale: Stripe ships an official CLI that 'helps you build, test, and manage your Stripe integration right from the terminal,' and a probe confirms it is documented at docs.stripe.com/stripe-cli. Stripe also positions agent-first developer tools as part of its platform. Missing for 10: evidence of Terminal-specific CLI commands (e.g., reader or simulator management), documentation of the CLI's use in AI/agent workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
